name: gateway_never_accepts_a_program
description: The one thing an unauthenticated integration can never do. A program is signed code that runs on every device in the mesh; accepting one over a channel anybody on the network can speak would make the signing pointless. This is not a policy a binding can widen - there is no ceiling high enough - so it is pinned as its own vector rather than as a case of the priority rule.

steps.description: not a question with two answers
and the ceiling any binding may be given stops below the status bands, so nothing arriving this way can suppress an alert
